facts.statement: compileDataflow.<locals>.build in archify/renderers/dataflow/dataflow-compiler.mjs has cyclomatic complexity 227 and nesting depth 6 (1517 lines). More independent paths make it harder to read and to test fully; this is a maintenance signal, not a defect.

impact.statement: Many independent paths through one function: it is harder to read, to review and to test every branch, and a change can miss a path.

suggestions.text: start at the deepest nested block: extract it into a named helper with its own tests
replace long if/elif chains on one value with a lookup table or dispatch
return early for edge cases so the main path is not nested
if the branching is inherent, raise the threshold in the analysis config rather than splitting artificially
